name: Cirrus Insight
description: Cirrus Insight is a sales-engagement and revenue-productivity platform for Gmail and Outlook, Salesforce synchronization, email tracking and outreach, scheduling, buyer signals, CRM workflows, and team analytics.
agentUseSummary: After Cirrus Insight enables the Scheduling Links API, add the issued organization UUID and one exact user email. Relay encrypts both identifiers and permits agents to read only at most ten bounded scheduling-link names, HTTPS URLs, and primary flags for that bound user. Meetings, availability, invitees, messages, engagement, Salesforce data, organization configuration, webhooks, administration, raw APIs, multi-user lookup, polling, bulk work, downloads, and exports remain excluded.

blocked.label: Change meetings or outreach
blocked.description: Booking, rescheduling, canceling, routing, emailing, blasting, following up, changing campaigns, and other external actions are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access people or content
blocked.description: Invitee identity, email addresses, form questions and answers, contacts, leads, messages, subjects, bodies, attachments, and engagement data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access private calendar data
blocked.description: Availability, calendar events, meeting IDs, conferencing details, owners, attendees, internal calendar identifiers, and raw calendar data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access organization or webhooks
blocked.description: Organization settings and profiles, users, teams, service accounts, domains, Salesforce sync, webhook events/endpoints/logs/signing keys, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call raw or bulk surfaces
blocked.description: Raw REST, arbitrary endpoints, multiple or caller-supplied emails, polling, event streams, imports, bulk work, downloads, exports, and crawling are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.description: The selected scheduling-link read runs without Relay approval while exact organization/user binding, fixed endpoint, audit, redaction, and response bounds remain enforced; meeting, people, calendar, webhook, organization, and write surfaces stay blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Cirrus Insight organization with the off-by-default Scheduling Links API enabled, issued organization UUID, exact configured user email, separate API agreement/permission, or live endpoint acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task ask Cirrus Insight to enable the Scheduling Links API under the customer's agreement, obtain the issued organization UUID, select one configured user email, store both through Relay, then validate the documented credential-free request contract, exact user binding, result bounds and redaction, approval/denial, feature revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial without booking or changing meetings.

evidence.supports: Official documentation defines the fixed GET /api/organizations/{org_id}/calendarviews endpoint, issued UUID organization identifier, comma-separated email query, scheduling-link response, and off-by-default feature that must be enabled by request; it documents no request token or OAuth header.
Official developer portal distinguishes supported APIs, webhooks, and data models for customer integrations.
Official webhook reference exposes organization configuration, users, service accounts, scheduling events, and other sensitive event data; Relay does not subscribe to that stream in V1.
Official meeting schema contains calendar foreign keys, owner and invitee identity, conferencing IDs, form questions/answers, timing, and other private meeting data excluded from V1.

Official privacy policy identifies names, email addresses, organization data, application data, CRM data, email and calendar content, and other PII processed by the service, supporting encrypted binding and strict redaction.
Official terms prohibit access outside provider interfaces unless specifically allowed by separate agreement, making provider enablement and permission a required external acceptance step.
